parade.cue.loudspeaker_1: LOUDSPEAKER: Attention. Residents of the reorganisation districts will line up in closed ranks behind the barrier.
parade.cue.loudspeaker_2: LOUDSPEAKER: Today the world sees what order can achieve.
parade.cue.loudspeaker_3: LOUDSPEAKER: Attendance is being recorded. Remain in your place.
parade.cue.konrad: KONRAD (thinking): I drew this axis. Room for a hundred thousand. Those who had to move out for it were in no plan.
parade.title: The Parade
parade.shot.p1: The square before the Great Hall
